message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: virtual invoicing (虚开增值税专用发票) for tax evasion, also possibly fraud, tax evasion, illegal handling of tax. The facts: they opened false VAT invoices for 6250 tons of corn, no real transaction, collected fee 125,000 RMB. This is classic crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (illegal issuance of special VAT invoices). Also possibly "骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" but here they didn't claim export refund, but they used for input tax deduction (though company is exempt). So the crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also maybe "非法经营"? But main is virtual invoice. Also "行贿" not present. So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪<eoa>

Check examples: they label as "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". In earlier examples they used that combined label. For similar case (曹某) they gave "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So we should use same label. So final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>
